dataset: 4 creator-described restoration cases (low variety, deliberately non-independent)

native_HS_symptoms: Does not turn on with batteries

ranked_differential.hypothesis: High-resistance or corroded battery terminal
tests_before_repair: Power removed: inspect battery contacts for corrosion or weak spring force
Measure continuity and voltage drop across contacts using an appropriate safe meter setup
Do not assume cleaning repairs a trace or via beyond the contact
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Restore/replace confirmed defective battery terminal, then verify supply path

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Open copper path between battery input and board power rail
tests_before_repair: With cells removed, compare continuity between terminal solder joint and next mapped power node
Inspect both sides, solder joints and vias for oxidation or lifted copper
Only bridge after confirming net identity, load and absence of a short
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Qualified low-voltage conductor restoration plus isolation and continuity checks

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Defective power switch
tests_before_repair: Remove cells and meter switch contacts in ON/OFF states
Inspect slide-switch solder joints for cracks
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Repair or replace verified faulty switch, not the entire logic board

initial.scoring: explicit human-authored rules, uncalibrated ranking, not an AI/video diagnosis

native_HS_symptoms: Game discs do not load or read
Device obtained as junk or for spares

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Disc optical pickup / laser module not reading
tests_before_repair: Compare with a known-good undamaged disc and verify normal spindle/focus behavior
Check mechanism and optical pickup service information; do not look into powered laser
Verify failure before replacing matched optical assembly
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Qualified pickup/drive replacement followed by official alignment and read tests

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Unreadable disc, dirty lens, or optical contamination
tests_before_repair: Use known-good disc and inspect readable surfaces for damage
Clean optics using approved nonabrasive procedure only if appropriate
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Service dirty media/optics and rerun read test before ordering laser

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Disc spindle / lid switch / mechanical alignment fault
tests_before_repair: Observe spindle behavior only with standard guard operation
Check switch or alignment according to service procedure; never bypass laser interlock
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Repair or replace documented mechanical fault, then repeat media-read tests

native_HS_symptoms: USB-C cable is used for charging

ranked_differential.hypothesis: Damaged USB-C receptacle or solder connections
tests_before_repair: Remove external power and inspect tongue, pins, anchors and underside joints under magnification
Inspect VBUS/GND continuity and CC lines using known-good pinout and dedicated USB-C tester
Check for shorts and lifted pads before any reflow or replacement
ranked_differential.conditional_repair_only_after_measuremen: Qualified microsoldering repair with magnification and post-repair USB-C tester verification
